meta.description: Q-readout: covariance from weights. Linear: live-edge measurement operator on the contrast space (rank, singular values), masked ridge / hinge / PSD recovery scored vs P C_hat P and P Sigma P, three error types, baselines; quadratic leak: full-C operator; rectifying: partial distance geometry only.

config.leaks: '0' none; 'u<k>' uniform quadratic leak k_i = k; 'h<k>' k_i ~ U(0,k) per neuron (stream [seed,4])
config.ridge: rho = 1e-10 sv_max^2 (min-norm on the identifiable subspace; unidentified part -> 0, a prior)
config.hinge: sum over dead pairs (2b - d^T Y d)_+^2, L-BFGS from the ridge solution

fields.lin[].runs[k]: analysis at b_grid[k] for (sigma, N, seed, leak); leak '0' = zero potential (unknown on the contrast space, dim 66); leaks u/h: unknown = full C (dim 78)
fields.ridge_psd_contrast_vs_Chat: leak arms: the full recovery restricted to the contrast space, vs P C_hat P
fields.noise<eps>_ridge_psd_vs_Chat_cos: Frobenius cosine vs C_hat target when every weight is multiplied by (1 + eps xi), xi ~ N(0,1), and the whole readout (H, operator, values) is recomputed from the noisy weights
fields.K, K_multi, largest, diam_max, span_over: cluster structure of the readout network (training bank), see fusion.json fields
fields.base_untrained_vs_<target>: random untrained network: same number of live edges at random pairs, w ~ U(0, b/alpha), formula applied (W = 0 itself has no live edge and gives nothing)
fields.n_live, dim: live edges (measurements) and dimension of the unknown symmetric matrix space
fields.rank_1e8 / rank_1e4: rank of the measurement operator at relative singular-value tolerance 1e-8 / 1e-4
fields.sv_max, sv_min_nonzero: largest and smallest (above 1e-8 relative) singular values of the operator (units: attachment-share^2)
fields.err_fixed_point: max over live edges |2(b - alpha w) - d^T C_hat d| (D^2 units): fixed-point/solver error
fields.err_sampling: ||P C_hat P - P Sigma P||_F / ||P Sigma P||_F (sampling error)
fields.err_inverse_identifiable: relative error of the ridge recovery projected on the identifiable subspace (singular values > 1e-4 of the largest) vs the target projected likewise
fields.<method>_vs_<target>: cos = Frobenius cosine; rel_err = ||Y - T||/||T||; bures_rel = Bures-Wasserstein distance / sqrt(Tr T); methods ridge, ridge_psd, hinge_psd; base_identity (c I fitted to live measurements), base_diag (nonneg diagonal fitted by NNLS), base_shuffled (weights permuted over pairs, formula applied)
fields.spectra[k]: seed 0, blocks, N=80, linear, at b_grid[k]: eigenvalues of the targets and recoveries on the contrast space, and the operator singular values
fields.nl[]: rectifying N=40 blocks (D_true = training bank, *_eval = independent evaluation bank): frac_exact (pairs with D known exactly = live), frac_upper_bounded (same component, not an edge: shortest-path upper bound), frac_lower_only (different components: only D >= sqrt(2b)); edge_err = max |sqrt(2(b - alpha w)) - D| on edges; sp_ratio = shortest-path / true D inside components; mds_procrustes_disparity of classical-MDS (3-D) embeddings of the largest component, completed vs true (0 = identical up to similarity); eval-bank versions: edge_rel_err_eval = max relative |weight-implied D - D_eval| on edges (sampling), sp_ratio_eval_median, lower_bound_holds_eval_frac = fraction of cross-component pairs with D_eval >= sqrt(2b), mds_procrustes_disparity_eval

meta.seed_streams: network attachments [seed,0]; thresholds [seed,3]; training bank [seed,1]; evaluation bank [seed,2]; random covariance presets fixed seed 12345
